environment: fictional-repo approval service and external dispatcher

in_scope: ordinary approval recording and mail outages

problem: In fictional-repo, receipt delivery currently runs inside the approval transaction. A mail outage rolls back approvals, preventing operators from recording and inspecting them.
outcome: The state store currently sends receipt emails during approval. A delivery outage prevents operators from recording approvals. Move delivery to the external dispatcher so approval records remain available during an outage.

acceptance.statement: Operators can record an approval and inspect its receipt status when email delivery is available.
Receipt delivery can be retried after a delivery error.

constraints: Existing approval identifiers and receipt contents stay unchanged.
non_goals: Changing reminder scheduling or email providers.
